title: How old are permits still listed in pre-issuance statuses?
question: How long have applications with an active pre-issuance status and no recorded issuance been on the books?
finding: On November 24, 10,126 applications filed since 2012 still had an active pre-issuance status, a valid filing date and no issuance or completion date. 7,623 were at least one year old and 5,639 at least three years old.
how: Age is November 24, 2026 less the calendar filing date. The strict active set is filed, filing, approved, plancheck, triage, issuing, incomplete and appeal. Closed, adverse, ambiguous and internally inconsistent statuses are excluded. These waits were still open when observed.
limits: A stale status can outlive an abandoned project. The register does not identify who held an application during these intervals. Expiration policy changed for certain permits filed on or after June 21, 2026 and has exceptions.
